select distinct d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ d.PS as psCode,/**交易方向Code**/ d.PS as ps,/**交易方向**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate,/**交易日**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as confirmDate,/**确认日**/ d.SHARE_AMT as shareAmt,/**交易份额**/ d.FEE_AMT as feeAmt, /**交易费用**/ d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /**交易金额**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as bookDate,/**入账日(交易日)**/ d.CCY as ccyCode,/**交易币种Code**/ d.CCY as ccy,/**交易币种**/
d.INT_AMT as intAmt,/**利息金额(利息总额)**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.cprice_Date,'%Y-%m-%d') as cpriceDate,/*净值日*/ d.UNIT_CPRICE as unitCprice,/**赎回净值（单位净价）**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate,/**预计到账日(交割日)**/ CASE d.PS WHEN 'T24' THEN DATE_FORMAT(stl.SETTLE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') END AS realDate,/**实际到账日（结算日）**/ d.TRADE_AMT as cashAmt,/**现金分红金额（交易金额）**/ d.Prin_Amt as bonusAmt,/**红利再投金额（交易金额）**/ d.SHARE_AMT as bonusShare,/**红利再投份额（交易份额）**/ d.INT_AMT as bAmt,/**应收红利（应收利息）**/ d.INT_AMT as realAmt,/**实收红利（交易金额）**/ d.TRADE_AMT as prinAmt,/**申购金额（交易本金）**/ d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,/**交易对手**/
d.CHL_ID as chlId,/**通道**/
tdf.FEE_AMT as tdFeeAmt,/**通道费**/ d.UNIT_INT as unitInt,/**单位分红（单位利息）**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType /**业务类型**/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' /**交易费用明细表**/ left join STL_ORDERS stl on stl.TRADE_ID = d.TRADE_ID and d.PS = 'T24' /**结算指令表**/ left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
